Billing typing fixes: list materialization fixed mypy; ledger timestamps now use timezone-aware UTC. Full main-repo suite: 96 passed; mypy clean. Test refactor added invoice and rollback fixtures; invoice tests: 46 passed. Separate repo suite: 318 passed, 4 skipped, but `test_apply_credit_after_refund` fails (`90.00` vs `87.50`).
